test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Charu is not the neighbour of Bhawna. Bhawna is second to the left of Hema. Geeta is the neighbour of Bhawna and Hema.

Who is sitting to the immediate left of Pooja?
solution: Given: Five friends Pooja, Bhawna, Charu, Geeta and Hema are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1) Bhawna is second to the left of Hema. 2) Geeta is the immediate neighbour of Bhawna and Hema.
